Application Data.NAME: Upholstery Pros, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Upholstery Pros, LLC provides high-quality upholstery services specializing in the repair, restoration, and customization of residential and commercial furniture. Our skilled technicians are formally trained in fabric handling, cleaning, and repair, ensuring adherence to industry best practices. We offer both in-shop and mobile services, maintaining comprehensive safety protocols for the handling of chemicals and materials. Our commitment to quality is backed by strong financial stability, a clean claims history, and adherence to documented safety measures, including secure inventory management and an alarm system to mitigate theft risks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a customer's antique chair was accidentally damaged during the repair process, resulting in a claim amount of $1,500. The loss has been reported to the insurance company and is currently under review. The status of the claim is pending.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the property, monitored by a central station alarm system, and on-site security watchpersons during non-operating hours.
